name: Kyoto International Manga Anime Fair
organizer: Kyoto International Manga Anime Fair Executive Committee, Kyoto City
blurb: Western Japan's largest manga and anime fair, held annually in September at Miyako Messe and ROHM Theatre Kyoto.
notes: KYOMAF 2026 (the 15th edition) ran September 19-20, 2026 at Miyako Messe / ROHM Theatre Kyoto, just before this research window opens; the homepage now shows 'thank you for coming' banners and news only up to 2026-08-06, with no 2027 date yet. KYOMAF is typically held the third Saturday/Sunday of September (per ja.wikipedia.org), which would put a 16th edition around September 2027, but no official date has been announced as of 2026-10-05, so no edition is listed rather than guessing one. Organizer confirmed via Wikipedia as the KYOMAF Executive Committee together with Kyoto City.
